text:
Jordan: Quick personal update — Alex and I just finalized the adoption paperwork for a rescue dog today!! 🎉🐶
Alex: He is 2 yrs old, super mellow, likes sunbeams and stealing socks. We haven’t picked a name yet. pics incoming.
Jordan: https://imgur.com/example (yes that face 😩)
Priya: OMG congrats!!! when can we meet pupper? :heart_eyes:
Maya: Name suggestions: Pickles, Nimbus, Mochi, or Chief. Vote by reaction. :raised_hands:
Evan: +1 for Mochi. also congrats you two!! :partyparrot:
Marco: Pickles forever. Also we should do a little adoption celebration in the office — cupcakes?
Kelly: I’ll bring cupcakes on Friday. who’s in for a 4pm puppy-obsession break? :cupcake: :dog:
Lee: Put me down. I can help with a leash/walk rota if you want — I live nearby.
sam: Love this. Quick Q: is the building OK with pets? might need a heads-up to facilities. @people-ops or @office-team?
Jordan: Good call — emailed facilities just now, they said as long as it’s leashed in common areas and not in shared desks it’s fine for a short visit.
Alex: Also open to name ideas from the team — if we get 3 different reactions we’ll pick the top one and reveal Friday. :thinking_face:
Priya: Mochi +1
Maya: Mochi :white_check_mark:
Marco: Pickles :point_right:
Kelly: Chief :muscle:
Lee: Nimbus :rocket:
Jordan: Love the chaos. Announcement RSVP: who can come Friday 4–4:30pm for cupcakes + meet the dog?
Priya: I can.
Evan: In.
Marco: Probably — penciled in.
Kelly: 100% yes, cupcakes are non-negotiable.
sam: I'll be remote but can drop a card on the desk. congrats again!!
Jordan: Thanks all — naming ceremony at 4:15 if you want to caucus. See you (and soon-to-be sock-thief) Friday. :smile:
